summary: Make desktop dual chat discoverable and route chat, IDE, terminal, context, forwarding, unread, notifications, and keyboard actions through explicit primary, secondary, focused, and displayed session identities.

reactNativeIos.reason: apps/mobile routes one ThreadScreen thread at a time and has no desktop pane, embedded IDE webview, or terminal-strip composition. This renderer-local workspace model does not change its existing read, push-presence, or API contracts.

nativeAndroid.reason: Native Android displays one thread route at a time and does not share Desktop ChatPanel, ThreadRichText, IDE, terminal, notification-click, or layout state. The unrelated oversized tool-summary-card issue remains outside this change.

sharedBackendApi.reason: Focused slots, displayed sessions, IDE binding, and composer registration are transient Desktop renderer state. Existing mark-read and single-thread viewing-lease calls are reused without changing runtime events, WebSocket messages, or old-client semantics.

storageDataMigration.reason: Primary, secondary, focus, and responsive presentation remain ephemeral renderer workspace state. Conversation/runtime rows, drafts keyed by session, and upgrade compatibility are unchanged; stale available-session reconciliation runs at renderer startup.

automated: Targeted Vitest suites for slot reconciliation, routing, close focus, context, forwarding, drafts, unread, notifications, IDE binding, terminal hydration, picker identity, and component contracts
notExercised: React Native/iOS and native Android dual-pane hardware checks are not applicable because both native apps present one thread at a time and share no Desktop workspace renderer.

Live remote-machine focus switching and live Claude, Codex, and OpenCode concurrent turns require credentials/machines available to the test environment; unexercised combinations are recorded in the completion report.
Desktop release signing is unaffected; any isolated packaged Electron scenario uses a temporary userData directory and no live Switchboard database.
